annotations.title: Search ChainChoice as a reader would

description: Reads a query exactly as ChainChoice's search bars do (the same resolver as the homepage, the navigation field and the command palette) and returns that reading: the page it opens (a category's ranked list with the country, monthly volume, sort and filters read from the words, a product's verdict, a two-product compare, a guide), or the question it asks with at most three options, each with the page it opens; `answer`, the card the bars show before a page opens (the published #1 or the named product, its ChainChoice Score and rank, the margin, why it leads, its main trade-off, the list's page and a link to watch it), every figure from the published ranking; `notRanked` instead, with `answer` null, when the reading opens a list that is not ranked right now (its line, the products it tracks A to Z, when we check again, its page and at most two ranked lists that do a similar job: no rank and no score); `readBy` when a model read a sentence the rules could not (only while ChainChoice's model tier is on and released by its measured eval); plus `open`, the homepage address that runs the same search. `country` applies a reader's country to a ranked list when the words name none; a country in the words wins. Nobody pays for a place in any answer.

query.description: The words a reader would type, e.g. "kraken or coinbase" or "best exchange for a German user".
